{
  "agentType": "database",
  "summary": {
    "overallRisk": "critical",
    "topConcern": "Serverless Prisma client not pooled + non-transactional coupon/order flows and N+1 writes on checkout.",
    "criticalCount": 3,
    "warningCount": 1,
    "infoCount": 1
  },
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "DB-1",
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "connection_pool",
      "title": "Prisma client not globally cached in production",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/lib/prisma.ts",
        "route": null,
        "function": "export const prisma",
        "pattern": "global cache used only when NODE_ENV !== 'production' — new PrismaClient created otherwise",
        "lines": "L1-L24"
      },
      "impact": "In serverless deployments new PrismaClient per cold start spawns DB connections; DB connection exhaustion and outages occur at ~50 concurrent function instances.",
      "fix": "Always reuse a single PrismaClient across invocations and/or deploy a DB pooler (pgbouncer) behind DATABASE_URL."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-2",
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "transaction",
      "title": "Coupon quantity decremented outside transaction",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts",
        "route": "/api/checkout/create-order (POST)",
        "function": "POST",
        "pattern": "await prisma.coupon.update(...) performed before order creation without wrapping coupon check+decrement+order creation in a transaction",
        "lines": "L40-L120"
      },
      "impact": "Concurrent checkouts can overspend limited coupons or leave coupon inventory inconsistent; breaks ~100 concurrent checkouts resulting in incorrect coupon quantities or double-claims.",
      "fix": "Wrap coupon validation+decrement and order creation in a single DB transaction or use atomic conditional update (WHERE quantity > 0) with affected-row check."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-3",
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "query_pattern",
      "title": "Sequential per-item DB writes (N+1) when updating orders",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts",
        "route": "/api/checkout/create-order (POST)",
        "function": "POST (existingOrder branch)",
        "pattern": "Loop over typedItems performing await prisma.orderItem.update/create/delete per item (serial awaits inside loop)",
        "lines": "L180-L320"
      },
      "impact": "Per-order O(N) DB operations per item; at ~500 concurrent checkouts with average 5 items this produces thousands of DB queries causing high latency and connection spikes.",
      "fix": "Batch upserts/delete with bulk operations inside a transaction (createMany/updateMany) or perform parallelized batched queries instead of serial awaits."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-4",
      "severity": "warning",
      "category": "query_pattern",
      "title": "Unbounded product list query (no pagination)",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/app/api/products/route.ts",
        "route": "/api/products (GET)",
        "function": "GET",
        "pattern": "prisma.product.findMany({ include: { colors: ... }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }) with no take/skip/cursor",
        "lines": "L1-L40"
      },
      "impact": "Returns full product table and related colors; as product count grows to 100k+, queries become slow, consume memory and increase DB load; degrades under moderate traffic.",
      "fix": "Add pagination (cursor/take/skip), limit included relations, and cache list endpoints (CDN/Redis)."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-5",
      "severity": "info",
      "category": "missing_cache",
      "title": "No cache layer for high-read endpoints",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "package.json / repo tree",
        "route": "/api/products, /api/best-sellers, product listing endpoints",
        "function": "N/A",
        "pattern": "No Redis/upstash/ioredis dependency and no caching utility present; product endpoints return full result sets",
        "lines": "N/A"
      },
      "impact": "All reads hit DB directly; increased latency and higher DB costs as traffic increases. (Informational.)",
      "fix": "Introduce caching for list endpoints (CDN or Redis), or cache at application layer for hot queries."
    }
  ],
  "scale": {
